profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer with expertise in backend enterprise microservices serving millions of customers. With a graduate degree from Columbia University and years of experience building software, Robert has all the necessary skills to design, implement, and maintain high-scale, reliable distributed systems using latest technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
▪ Oversee and lead design, development, testing, and maintenance of fraud prevention backend platform for
1M+ customers: functional requirements, domain contracts, edge cases, architecture design, presentations,
coding, performance testing, deployment using CI/CD pipeline, RTE and prod support
▪ Spearhead design and architecture of a new bank data verification tool involving 7 backend teams and 3
front end teams, collaborating with tech stakeholders and presenting to the LTs
▪ Demonstrated a proven track record of being able to break down a project in actionable items, communicate
effectively with product & tech stakeholders, and create refined Jira tickets for the team
▪ Mentored 4 junior engineers and interns, discussing goals, roadmap, and motivating for future projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Migrated monolith customer authentication fraud detection application to multiple Java & Python platforms,
streamlining new business use cases onboarding, shortening by 75%, and eliminating arbitrary uniqueness
▪ Enhanced platform capabilities by adding AWS SQS queues between two microservices and additional
Kafka consumers for a new business partnership with REI
▪ Presented and actively participated in fraud architecture reviews, learn and share series, and hackathons

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Lead
positions.description:
▪ As a 5th member of a startup, scaled hardware products to 100+ units deployed in 6 major metro areas
▪ Enhanced TCP protocol in C and built automated fleet reporting tool in Python using REST APIs

company.name: Venture Development Center at UMass Boston

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Lead
positions.description:
▪ Collaborated with cross functional teams, grew a startup from 8 to 40 members and reached series A
▪ Modified consumer electronics firmware and Linux Kernel bootup procedure to improve user experience

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Coop
positions.description: ▪ Tested beta prototypes and enhanced stepper motor performance by implementing microstepping in C

positions.title: Hardware Engineering Coop
positions.description: ▪ Launched Altium Version Control System to improve version tracking for all electrical teams

projects.title: Research on Networked Storage and Query Processing
projects.description:
▪ Assisting Jan Janak with research on IoT spatiotemporal sensor data by simulating 10,000 devices in Python
publishing to MQTT topics and populating data into dozens of PostgreSQL databases to evaluate a new kind
of storage/query architecture based on Presto distributed SQL query engine
